scope: Saved typed-MCP default noninteractive regression plans for Vectorworks 2027 on Windows; historical observations independently re-evaluated offline.

method: Validated saved plan/result provenance, ordered request identity, substituted captures, assertion declarations and recomputed outcomes with import_sdk_regression.validate_bound_run.
Rechecked every completed family with run_sdk_regression_batch._passed_family.
Matched every result row to its journal, typed request/response, successful disposable-document guard and actual deployed four-file SDK source hashes.
Validated each measured GetVersionEx prelude and exact common source/fixture pins; compared executed plans to their reserved batch plans.
Matched completed-family union to current default family selection; diagnostic and characterization families receive no credit.

limitations: This is a union of fresh completed family runs, not one uninterrupted batch. A and B remain blocked in their original records. C recreated the interrupted bounds family with a fresh run ID; the 40 earlier successful jobs remain additional observations.

Jobs include compatibility replacements and local behavior; totals do not mean every job or API executed its original native function. Guard probes and the final save are excluded from fixture counts.

Passing this selected suite does not establish all 3,098 SDK APIs, all inputs, excluded families, or arbitrary native object lifecycles. Setter return success alone is not a geometry-effect assertion; original linked readback assertions retain their exact scope.

This report makes no focus-preservation claim. Native binary identity and broader deployment verification belong to separate deployment evidence; per-job pins here cover the four SDK Python/catalog files.
